## About
Meszaros Motor Sports is a collision and auto repair shop on Upland Dr in Houston. We bring ASE certified master technicians and certified body and paint technicians together, so one shop can handle your mechanical repairs, factory recommended maintenance and body work.
If you've been in an accident, we know it's usually an unpleasant experience. We work with you to understand the damage, and with your insurance company to repair your car to factory condition. Whether it's an oil change, an alignment, a dent or a full collision repair, we aim to do it right the first time.
Drivers have given us a 4.4 rating across 247 Google reviews, and many of them mention the same thing: they were kept updated every step of the way.

## Services
- Collision repair: We repair accident damage using computerized frame equipment and a computerized paint mixing system, and we look after you from the first estimate to the finished car.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents taken out without repainting the panel.
- Auto glass repair and replacement: Chipped or broken glass repaired or replaced.
- Factory recommended maintenance: The scheduled services, inspections and part replacements your manufacturer recommends, including tune-ups and oil changes.
- Brake service and repair: Call us as soon as you notice your brakes acting up so we can fix them before more damage occurs.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Service and repair to keep your air conditioning working.
- Computer diagnostics: Tracking down the cause of stalling, overheating or other unusual behavior.
- Pre-purchase inspection: A look over a used car before you buy it.
- Suspension and steering repair: Repair for suspension and steering problems, along with alignment and tire mounting, balancing and repair.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 6:00 pm. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with you to understand the damage and with your insurance company to repair your car to factory condition.

Q: Can you work on my car?
A: We service every make and model, for both mechanical repairs and body work.

Q: Is there a charge for an estimate?
A: No. Our computerized estimates are free.
